set.body: Source-inspection follow-up from family summary admission bd-01M47BDR7J7FKGXESZFY9J370P. HrfKernelBasis.compile in modules/design/.../hrf/KernelBasis.scala now preflights the scalar tail diagnostic before sampled allocation and returns Summary errors, but nodesPerAxis.product, gridPoints*components, builder dimensions/cells, jet scratch, retained phi and certification projection/tail work remain unchecked as aggregate budgets. Positive node values can overflow Int products or request huge matrices even with an admitted scalar lag grid. Add inspectable documented allocation/work budgets before conversions/builders/callbacks/SVD, cover chart widths/interpolated nodes becoming nonfinite, and use existing Gale capabilities without implementing private spectral kernels. Include actual emitted matrix/rank/certificate quantities in estimates, shared JVM+JS overflow/exact-boundary/sentinel regressions, and bounded mutation evidence. Preserve admitted scientific numerics and structural identities. This is source inspection, not a deliberately huge compilation experiment.
